entities.name: Query UbiE methyltransferase
observations: The 229-aa sequence matches reviewed UbiE proteins at 47.8–59.7% identity with 95.6–98.3% query coverage and E-values of 1.1e-59 to 1.9e-91.
Pfam scanning identifies Ubie_methyltran (PF01209.25) across residues 3–226.
Homology supports a quinone C-methyltransferase involved in menaquinone and possibly ubiquinone biosynthesis; exact substrate usage is inferred from homologs.

entities.name: DMKH2 methylation to MKH2
observations: Demethylmenaquinol is methylated using S-adenosyl-L-methionine, producing menaquinol, S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine, and H+; reaction corresponds to EC 2.1.1.163 and Rhea:42640 in reviewed UbiE homologs.
For the query sequence, this reaction is a strong homology-based assignment rather than direct biochemical measurement.

entities.name: DDMQH2 methylation to DMQH2
observations: 2-polyprenyl-6-methoxy-1,4-benzoquinol is methylated using S-adenosyl-L-methionine, producing 2-polyprenyl-3-methyl-6-methoxy-1,4-benzoquinol, S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine, and H+; associated with EC 2.1.1.201 and Rhea:28286 in a close UbiE homolog.
This additional ubiquinone-related activity is plausible but less certain for the query than the conserved demethylmenaquinol methyltransferase activity.
